player_prompt.intro:
Aɖeke ƒo 2048 le {board_size}x{board_size} taɖi dzi. Aƒeme aɖeke nye be na aɖu {target_tile} taɖi ɖe kple dzidzɔ dzidzɔ wɔwɔ ƒe xexlẽwo!
Dziɖuɖu siwo sɔgbɔ: [Up], [Down], [Left], [Right]. Taɖiwo laɖiɖi ƒe xexlẽwo wɔwɔ ƒe agbɔsɔsɔ.

invalid_move.invalid_action: Ɖe si wɔ na nyatefe. Tsɔ '[Up]'/'[Down]'/'[Left]'/'[Right]'.
invalid_move.no_change: Dɔdzikpɔhaa metrɔ o - etia mɔ bubu.

outcome.win: Akpe, mi gblɔ be {target_tile}! Agbalɛ fɔfɔ {score}.
outcome.lose: Dziɖuɖu meɖo o. Taɖi gãtɔ {max_tile} - akɔnta titina {score}.
